instruction: Find all men's small-size short-sleeve shirts with a discount of 40% or more.

metadata.explanation: Variation 6: Changed size from L to S, discount from 50% to 40%, keeps short-sleeve. Maintains same complexity and interaction pattern as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic error in getter function: Price_discount_range check is hardcoded for '50_PERCENT_ off & more' (chrome.py:2551) but expected value requires '40_PERCENT_ off & more'
The getter will return 'not_50_PERCENT_ off & more' even if URL contains '40_PERCENT_ off & more', causing evaluation to always fail for 40% discount
Lines 2550-2554 in get_macys_product_url_parse contain the flawed logic that only checks for 50% discount, not 40%
The evaluator can verify 4 out of 5 requirements correctly (mens_clothing, shirts, size, short_sleeve) but fails on the discount requirement
Incomplete coverage: Cannot verify the '40% or more discount' requirement due to hardcoded 50% logic
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix getter logic in chrome.py lines 2550-2554: Replace hardcoded '50_PERCENT_ off & more' check with generic logic that can handle any discount percentage
Update condition to extract the actual discount value from URL and return it as-is, rather than checking against hardcoded '50_PERCENT_'
Alternative: Add support for multiple discount thresholds (40%, 50%, etc.) and return the appropriate value based on what's in the URL
Consider making the discount check configurable via the parse_keys or a separate parameter rather than hardcoding specific percentages
